Fix `excalidraw-app/collab/Collab.tsx` for these problems, changing only what they need, following the conventions in the shared brief:
1. Gate 3 security finding (person accepted, must fix): applyRemotePages (~line 840, called from the websocket SCENE_INIT / SCENE_UPDATE handlers ~619 and ~636) reconciles the decrypted remote page records without sanitizing them, unlike the Firebase path (firebase.ts decryptPages uses restorePageState). A collaborator can send a page whose `name` is an object (crashes PagesTabBar rendering {page.name}) or a huge `version`. Fix: at the start of applyRemotePages, replace the payload with the sanitized records — `const remotePages = restorePageState({ pages: rawRemotePages }).pages` (restorePageState is exported from "@excalidraw/element"; check its exact signature in packages/element/src/pages.ts) — and ignore a non-array payload. instruction:
Fix `packages/excalidraw/history.ts` for these problems, changing only what they need, following the conventions in the shared brief:
1. AC-3 / FR-21 product bug the person rejected at Gate 3: undo does not stay on its page. Test packages/excalidraw/tests/pages.test.tsx 'keeps undo on its page' (~line 313): add page 2, switch back to the default page, seed r1 (default page) and r2 (page 2), select r1 and press ArrowRight (r1.x=1), switch to page 2, select r2, press ArrowRight (r2.x=1), switch back to the default page, undo -> expected r1.x 0 but it stays 1. Already ruled out: (a) App.componentDidUpdate now calls history.setActivePage AFTER store.commit; (b) the store's observed appState has no page fields; (c) actionSwitchPage uses CaptureUpdateAction.NEVER and IMMEDIATELY outranks NEVER in Store.getScheduledMacroAction; (d) undo receives all pages' elements (actionManager passes scene.getElementsIncludingDeleted()). Remaining suspects to check and fix: History.perform's loop pops entries while `containsVisibleChange` is false and pushes them to the redo stack — with per-page stacks, an entry recorded while page A was active may be judged invisible (AppStateDelta.filterInvisibleChanges checks selectedElementIds against nextElements; the page switch cleared selection) and the loop then continues into an EARLIER entry or exits without applying the move; also check that record() pushes to the stack of the page whose elements changed, not the page active at commit time — make History.record route a delta to the page of the elements it changes (look up each changed element's pageId via getElementPageId on the delta's inserted/deleted element partials, falling back to the active page), and make undo/redo apply only the active page's stack. Keep the per-page Map design. Edits only.
